title: device request body vnc.open
description: the owner asks for a VNC connection to the screen of a sandbox that waits for a human (ADR-103): kind login (id = the claude.login request whose check for humans waits) or session (id = the session whose platform browser is open). Only the owner's own identity may send it (the device answers an agent's request failed forbidden, the hub refuses the agent's tunnel); no follow-up requests
